review_method: Visual inspection of every second decoded frame across the entire MP4 plus native-resolution transition frames, followed by native initial PNG
initial_scene: A white articulated robot stands at the rear of a white rectangular table, its open two-finger gripper suspended above a cluster of colorful produce. A separate orange carrot with green leaves lies diagonally at the front-left, with the leaves toward the viewer. An empty shallow lavender plate sits at the front-right beside a circular tabletop cable opening. Black curtains stand behind and to the left of the robot; silver window blinds and a light wood shelf/cart are on the right, with computer equipment visible at the far left.

observed_sequence.action: The raised open gripper holds its starting pose above the back of the table.
The arm moves forward and down, aligning its open fingers on opposite sides of the separate carrot body.
The gripper closes around the carrot while the carrot remains near the tabletop, then holds still before lifting.
The arm lifts the gripped carrot clear of the table and carries it rightward toward the lavender plate.
The gripper positions the carrot over the plate and lowers it to the plate surface.
The fingers open, releasing the carrot; it settles diagonally on the lavender plate with its green leaves hanging toward the near rim and cable opening.
The open gripper pauses immediately above the placed carrot, which stays on the plate.
The empty gripper rises and withdraws toward the rear of the table; the carrot remains on the lavender plate.

selected_segment.reason: The entire clip contains one continuous completed carrot pick-and-place, including grasp, transport, release, settling, and empty-gripper withdrawal; there is no second independent subtask.
selected_segment.terminal_state: The carrot rests diagonally on the lavender plate with its leafy end over the near rim, while the open empty gripper is raised above and behind it.
